comments.body: I can present a brief udpate of what has been done on Prysm side.
I would also like to present a quick summary of my updates.

Quick update from Nethermind team:
- We achieved e2e block proving with Zisk. Currently polishing and optimising.
- We established collaboration with Nethereum project on dotnet zkvm compatibility.
- We are planning to integrate with ethproofs soon.
- We are progressing with implementing/refactoring emerging standards for EL guest programs.

At Nethermind, we would like more attention to the proposed changes to the zkVM standard, such as a broader crypto API (for now, just the [Keccak-f permutation](https://github.com/eth-act/zkvm-standards/pull/26)) and basic [standard output](https://github.com/eth-act/zkvm-standards/pull/27) capabilities for debugging purposes. Those [issues](https://github.com/eth-act/zkvm-standards/issues/23) have been open for more than a month and are still hanging with no progress.

We’ve seen the issues around the proposed zkVM standard changes and will make sure they get responses and forward progress soon. The broader crypto API discussion and debugging capabilities are both on our radar.

Also, @rubo  you are encouraged to open a dedicated issue for IO standard improvements in the zkvm-standards repository issues so the discussion can be tracked more clearly alongside the other standardization work. That's regarding the shared concern around Zisk `read_input` implementation provided by you.

Thanks!
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
